text: I want to share my experience at MH Tel Aviv this week: Our appointment to extend A5 had been cancelled and we had received a message to come to MH in person to schedule a new appointment. Went there at 7, still took until 10. Bottom line: we got the current extended visa and re-entry in my passport, they mentioned that we need to show the receipt in the next meeting and will not have to pay for the next extension. We got a new appointment in 3 weeks and don’t need to bring any additional documents besides what we already uploaded for the cancelled appointment
